# GOTS - Global Organic Textile Standard

> The leading global certification standard for organic textiles, covering sustainable production from fiber to finished product with rigorous environmental, social, and supply chain requirements.

GOTS provides comprehensive certification for organic textile manufacturing with third-party verification, human rights protection, and due diligence compliance. The standard covers all processing stages and maintains strict criteria for approved chemicals, fibers, and manufacturing practices across the global textile supply chain.

## Key Topics

- Organic textile certification
- GOTS Version 7.0
- Third-party certification
- Due diligence requirements
- Supply chain traceability
- Environmental criteria
- Human rights and social criteria
- OECD compliance
- Approved chemicals and accessories
- ISEAL standards
- Textile processing stages
- Sustainability standards
- Certification requirements
- Global Responsible Textile Standard

## Core Standard Information

- [Home - GOTS - Global Organic Textile Standard](https://global-standard.org): GOTS homepage introducing the leading organic textile standard with certification and training
- [The Standard - GOTS - Global Organic Textile Standard](https://global-standard.org/the-standard): Overview of GOTS features, values, and certification for organic textile processing
- [Philosophy - GOTS - Global Organic Textile Standard](https://global-standard.org/the-standard/philosophy): GOTS mission, values, and approach to responsible textile production sustainability
- [Key Features - GOTS - Global Organic Textile Standard](https://global-standard.org/the-standard/gots-key-features): GOTS key features including certification, human rights, and due diligence requirements

## Certification Requirements & Criteria

- [Organic Fibres - GOTS - Global Organic Textile Standard](https://global-standard.org/the-standard/gots-key-features/organic-fibres): GOTS specifications for organic fibres including cotton, linen, and hemp certification
- [Environmental Criteria - GOTS - Global Organic Textile Standard](https://global-standard.org/the-standard/gots-key-features/ecological-and-social-criteria): GOTS environmental and social criteria for sustainable textile manufacturing processes
- [Human Rights and Social Criteria - GOTS - Global Organic Textile Standard](https://global-standard.org/the-standard/gots-key-features/human): GOTS human rights and social criteria including labor protection and worker equality
- [All Processing Stages - GOTS - Global Organic Textile Standard](https://global-standard.org/the-standard/gots-key-features/all-processing-stages): GOTS requirements covering all textile processing stages from fiber to finished product
- [Chemicals and Accessories Approval - GOTS - Global Organic Textile Standard](https://global-standard.org/the-standard/approval-of-chemicals-and-accessories): GOTS approved chemicals and accessories list with strict manufacturing input criteria

## Compliance & Verification

- [Third-Party Certification - GOTS - Global Organic Textile Standard](https://global-standard.org/the-standard/gots-key-features/third-party-certification): GOTS third-party certification process with accreditation and quality assurance standards
- [Traceability - GOTS - Global Organic Textile Standard](https://global-standard.org/the-standard/gots-key-features/traceability): GOTS traceability and supply chain verification requirements for certified textiles
- [Due Diligence - GOTS - Global Organic Textile Standard](https://global-standard.org/the-standard/gots-key-features/due-diligence): GOTS due diligence requirements aligned with supply chain compliance legislation
- [Compliance Support - GOTS - Global Organic Textile Standard](https://global-standard.org/the-standard/gots-key-features/compliance-support): GOTS compliance support aligned with EU sustainability and circular economy standards
